annotations.title: Rise, set and twilight times for a place

description: Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset and twilight times for a place and date: rise, transit and set of the Sun, Moon and planets, civil/nautical/astronomical dawn and dusk, day length, golden hour and blue hour, in UTC and local time. E.g. {date: '2026-06-21', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. For sky, weather, photography and outdoor apps: for one local calendar day at a place (time zone and DST resolved from the coordinates), each body's rise and set (with azimuth) and upper transit (with altitude), or 'always_up' / 'always_down' when it neither rises nor sets (polar day and night); for the Sun, dawn and dusk at -6, -12 and -18 degrees, solar noon, day length, and the golden hour (Sun between -4 and +6 degrees) and blue hour (-6 to -4) intervals. Times in UTC to the second, local time with its offset, and unix timestamps; every convention (refraction, limb, horizon) is in result.settings. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/rise-set (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

bodies.description: Bodies to time. Default: all ten (Sun, Moon, Mercury..Pluto). The Sun's twilight block is always returned.

date.description: The local calendar day at the place, YYYY-MM-DD (1800-01-02..2199-12-30), midnight to midnight in its time zone.

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: rise_set_times

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

bodies.description: One row per body: rise and set {utc, local (ISO 8601 with offset), timestamp (unix seconds)} with azimuth, transit with altitude (null when it does not happen that day), and state: rises_and_sets, rises_only, sets_only, always_up or always_down.

settings.description: The bodies timed and every convention: observer model, rise/set limb and refraction, twilight and golden/blue hour altitudes.

subject.description: The place (latitude, longitude, elevation_m), its time zone and how it was found, the local date and the day's window in UTC (midnight to midnight local time).

sun.description: sunrise, solar_noon, sunset, civil/nautical/astronomical dawn and dusk (null when the Sun does not reach that depth), day_length_minutes, golden_hour and blue_hour intervals [{period, start, end}].

title: Rise, set and twilight times for a place
